sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Sweden – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: national income tax 20% above SEK 643,000 (2026), average municipal tax rate 32%, capital income 30%.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Sweden – Corporate – Other taxes
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: VAT 25%, 12% and 6%; employers’ social fees about 31.42% (from 1 January 2024, even for those under 18); special salary tax about 24% on additional pension premiums.
